 eResponse Instructions
CSP 6100 CLMB348A  View Details
Due Date: 10/22/2026 at 2PM
2026 IDIQ Chilled Water Construction In The ROW Reissue
To facilitate the expansion and maintenance of Austin Energy’s district energy chilled water system by connecting new customers through the installation of chilled water piping and related infrastructure within the City of Austin Right of Way. This includes excavation, tunneling, dewatering, traffic control, and integration with existing systems. The contract ensures reliable service delivery, infrastructure resilience, and alignment with Austin Energy’s long-term operational goals

ESB - MACC Audio and Lighting Production

Various Traffic Signal Cables
City of Austin requesting various Traffic Signal Cables for upcoming installation and maintenance projects
IFB 1100 AGM1008  View Details
Due Date: 10/27/2026 at 2PM
Capacitor Banks and Associated Parts
This contract requires a qualified Contractor to supply and deliver capacitor banks and associated parts on an as-needed basis for use in the maintenance, repair, and operation of Austin Energy's electrical distribution system. The capacitor banks and associated parts shall meet the requirements of the applicable technical specifications identified in this solicitation.
IFB 6100 CLMC1176  View Details
Due Date: 10/29/2026 at 2PM
Williamson Creek - Tributary 4 Channel Stabilization
Williamson Creek Trib 4 is experiencing severe erosion affecting multiple single-family and commercial properties. The project will armor stream banks, restore stable channel geometry, and rehabilitate the riparian ecosystem along the project reach. Any utilities affected by the channel degradation will either be relocated or protected from future damage. The project will also include the replacement, relocation and abandonment of wastewater main within Williamson Creek Tributary 4. The project will also focus on two locations of the tributary, approximately 950 LF between Eberhart Lane and Turtle Creek Boulevard and approximately 400 LF downstream of W Stassney Lane
IFB 7800 MLJ1046  View Details
Due Date: 10/29/2026 at 2PM
Bulk Motor Fuels and Fuel-Related Products & Services
Procure unleaded gasoline, ethanol fuels, diesel, biodiesel, renewable diesel, DEF, and special fuel-related services. The objective is to engage a singular vendor capable of delivering a comprehensive, cost-effective contract for bulk motor fuels and fuel-related products and services for the entirety of the City’s vehicle and equipment fleet.
RFP 1100 DCM3051  View Details
Due Date: 10/29/2026 at 2PM
Commercial Demand Response Program Expansion
To provide the necessary resources (time and materials) to support Austin Energy’s Demand Response programs, with an emphasis on the expansion of the Commercial Demand Response program, to reach goals outlined in the Austin Energy Resource, Generation, and Climate Protection Plan to 2035.
RFP 7500 SMW3037  View Details
Due Date: 10/29/2026 at 2PM
Facility Condition Assessments
This solicitation is intended to acquire services to provide for ongoing assessments of City owned building systems with a lifecycle cost analysis including current capital investment, current operating costs, future capital replacement costs, and risk analysis.
RFI 1100 MTL6000  View Details
Due Date: 11/02/2026 at 2PM

Improvement Online Software Training RFI
IFB 2200 BYS1060  View Details
Due Date: 11/03/2026 at 2PM
Leak Detection Services
The contract will provide leak detection services for an estimated five hundred (500) linear miles of the City’s water distribution system per year. A survey mile shall mean one (1) linear mile of water distribution main assigned by the City through GIS mapping, regardless of the number of appurtenances inspected within that mile. The Contractor shall provide all materials, equipment, transportation, and labor to fulfill the requirements of this Scope of Work.
IFB 5000 ACA1012REBID  View Details
Due Date: 11/03/2026 at 2PM
Rental of Portable Toilets and Showers
The City seeks a contract for rental, delivery, maintenance, and service of portable toilets. The portable toilets will be rented on an annual, monthly, weekly, or daily basis to include holidays, weekends, and special events.
RFP 1500 RGW3015  View Details
Due Date: 11/03/2026 at 2PM
Education, Clean up, Restoration and Beautification Services
The City of Austin (“City”) seeks Contractors qualified to provide education, cleanup, beautification, and restoration services benefiting the public through a variety of programs and resources that inspire effective environmental stewardship among residents and improve Austin’s environment and aesthetics.
IFB 5000 ALD1022  View Details
Due Date: 11/05/2026 at 2PM
Interior and Exterior Window Washing Services
Window Washing Services
IFB 6100 CLMC1105  View Details
Due Date: 11/05/2026 at 2PM
Distribution Getaway Duct Bank Bore at East Village subst
The Work shall include furnishing all tools, labor, materials, equipment, and miscellaneous items necessary for the complete construction of approximately 342 linear foot 36-inch jack and bore with 12-5 inch carrier pipes (grouted within the casing pipe) in ground water conditions. The work also includes 386 linear feet of 12-5 inch open cut duct bank, 79 linear feet of 2-5 inch open cut duct bank, two 12’x12’ manholes and typical erosion and sedimentation control and revegetation. Austin Energy will install the conductors at the project completion.
RFP 1100 LLM3010  View Details
Due Date: 11/05/2026 at 2PM
Weather Services and Decision Dashboard
Seeking a software solution capable of delivering utility-grade weather forecasting, real-time meteorologist support, and a configurable decision-making dashboard to enhance operational planning and storm response.
RFP 2200 MLJ3013  View Details
Due Date: 11/05/2026 at 2PM
Customer Plumbing Services
The City of Austin (City) seeks to establish a Contract with qualified Contractor(s) to provide residential and commercial plumbing services in coordination with Austin Water and its customers.
IFB 1100 DPL1010  View Details
Due Date: 11/10/2026 at 2PM
Austin Energy Landscaping and Grounds Maintenance Services
Landscaping, Ground Maintenance and Irrigation Services for Austin Energy substations, power plants, vacant lots, and facilities.
RFP 8100 SLW3035  View Details
Due Date: 11/10/2026 at 2PM
Airport Parking Management Operations
The City seeks proposals for Parking Operation Management Services from parking management Contractors who are qualified and experienced in managing and operating major public parking garages, surface lots and transportation services for these public facilities, with separate employee parking and transportation service.
IFB 2200 JRN1044  View Details
Due Date: 11/12/2026 at 2PM
Portable Gas Detection Monitors & Maintenance
This contract is to provide leasing services for portable gas detection equipment, calibration services, maintenance, repair, loaner units, calibration gas, and training.
IFB 6100 CLMC1100  View Details
Due Date: 11/12/2026 at 2PM
Lower Fort Branch Basin - Wastewater Pipeline Renewal
The Work consists of wastewater pipeline improvements including installation of approximately 11,320 LF of 6- and 8-inch diameter PVC pipe for wastewater main and services and approximately 181 LF of 6- and 12- inch ductile iron waterline and the rehabilitation of approximately 236 LF of existing 8-inch diameter wastewater pipe using Cured-In-Place-Pipe lining method. Incidental work includes erosion and sedimentation control, pavement repair, stormwater pollution prevention plan (SWPPP), and traffic control during construction.
IFB 6200 BYS1062  View Details
Due Date: 11/17/2026 at 2PM
Span Wire and Communications Supplies
The purpose of this contract is to provide span wire hardware and communications equipment related to Traffic Signal infrastructure throughout the City.
RFP 1100 DCM3050  View Details
Due Date: 11/17/2026 at 2PM
Strategic Energy Management Services
Experienced Strategic Energy Management program provider to coordinate with the Austin Energy program team and provide large institutional and commercial property portfolios in Austin with the firm’s existing statistical- and behavioral focused energy management services.
IFB 2200 DCG1041  View Details
Due Date: 11/19/2026 at 2PM
Leak Detection Dog Services
The City of Austin (City) seeks to establish a contract to provide a trained Leak Detection dog and/or professional services to support water loss control and wastewater system efficiency.
IFB 6100 CLMC1141  View Details
Due Date: 11/19/2026 at 2PM
John Trevino Jr. Metro Park - Phase I Development
This phase of development includes a wildflower meadow, invasive species removal, picnic shelters, playground amenities including nature play, trail and sidewalk connections, a formalized entry point, access road, parking, rain gardens, shade and ornamental trees, utility improvements, and a restroom.
IFB 6100 CLMC970  View Details
Due Date: 11/19/2026 at 2PM
North Lamar Blvd Corridor-North of Parmer Ln to Howard Ln
Design and construction of projects including bicycle and pedestrian facilities, intersection improvements, raised center medians, upgraded traffic signals and bus stops.
RFQS 6100 CLMP397  View Details
Due Date: 12/01/2026 at 2PM
TPW Transportation Professional Staff Augmentation
TPW seeks a qualified consultant for skilled engineering staff to augment existing TPW workforce in the delivery of duties in the TPW Divisions. This includes both staff and engineering work assignments across several TPW divisions.
IFB 6100 CLMC1173  View Details
Due Date: 12/10/2026 at 2PM
Boggy Creek MLK TOD Strmwater Conveyance Improvements Ph-3
This project completes the third phase of implementation of stormwater conveyance infrastructure improvements in the MLK-TOD funded by the Watershed Protection Department.
RFQS 6100 CLMP401  View Details
Due Date: 12/15/2026 at 2PM
Davis Water Treatment Plant Filter System Improvements
Issue a Request for Qualification to provide engineering services for the preliminary, design and construction phase services to assess the existing filter system at the Davis WTP to make recommendations for changes and improvements.
Important Notices
No Lobbying Report
The No Lobbying List contains solicitations issued by Central Procurement and all other delegated authorities.
All Vendors must now register with the City of Austin before they submit a bid or proposal. Please take the time to read the information in the Conflict of Interest Disclosure: https://www.austintexas.gov/services/submit-conflict-interest-form.
City of Austin employees may not accept any gifts from vendors. Please do not offer or provide gifts or favors to City employees or to City offices. This includes paying for meals.
ALL BIDS AND COMPLIANCE PLANS NOT RECEIVED PRIOR TO THE DATE AND TIME SET FORTH WILL BE RETURNED TO THE BIDDER UNOPENED.
